topic: Use AI to rehearse a hard conversation
hook: Dreading a talk with your manager? Rehearse it first.
sentences: Ask your assistant to play your manager.
Tell it the situation in two or three plain sentences.
Say your opening line out loud, then type it.
Let it push back the way a busy person might.
Try again until your first sentence feels calm and clear.
Walking in prepared changes how you sound.
cta: Save this before your next big conversation.
caption:
Practice with AI before the real conversation.
